findings.governingReading: こうしている自分 continues the object of Sakura's rejection: herself in this state, then her bloodied/blackened self and connected shadow.
findings.explanation: Rejecting her present self becomes a past deed.

findings.highlight: I-if you come any closer, I won't be able to hold it back. I'll kill you before you can kill me...!"
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩、先輩がそれ以上近寄るなら、わたしだって我慢しません。先輩に殺される前に、わたしが先輩を殺しちゃうんだから……！」
findings.governingReading: わたしだって我慢しません threatens that she too will stop restraining herself if he comes closer.
findings.explanation: Threatened refusal to restrain herself becomes inability.

findings.highlight: "That won't happen at all. I'm going to get you out of here and save Tohsaka. I already told you that, Sakura."
findings.evidenceJa: 「どうしても何もない。桜をここから連れ出して、遠坂を助ける。さっきそう言っただろう、桜」
findings.governingReading: どうしても何もない dismisses her why-question and repeats his already stated purpose: take her out and save Rin.
findings.explanation: Answering why he advances becomes denial that the threatened event will happen.

findings.governingReading: 気が遠くなる describes consciousness receding/faintness while he still moves, speaks and projects before self disappears.
findings.explanation: Faintness becomes completed loss of consciousness.

findings.highlight: Shadows strike at my shoulder, chest, left leg, and stomach.
findings.evidenceJa: 肩と胸、右足と腹に影が突き刺さる。
findings.governingReading: Shadow strikes target shoulder, chest, right leg and abdomen; the next line explicitly denies penetration.

findings.highlight: Like this is going to be her final punishment.
findings.evidenceJa: これが、桜に下される罰になるように。
findings.governingReading: これが、桜に下される罰になるように is a wish/purpose: may this become the punishment imposed on Sakura.
findings.explanation: Hope that the strike will constitute punishment becomes a comparison with final punishment.
